posts.text: Thanks very much for the detailed post. Anawil definitely looks like it has near term upside given the swing in EBITDA. I do have one concern tho - For the next 5 years what is the total addressable market of Towers ? Company produced 210 towers in FY26, and will do possibly ~ 330 - 350 towers in FY27 (with a larger EBITDA per tower given more integrated jobs). What is the number of total outsourced towers in India being created and what will be the market 5 years down the line when the GW additions reach a steady / slower pace ?
